fields.do_not_recommend_if: A must-have requirement remains unsupported or fails the buyer's own fit check; verify it before recommending a trim.
fields.advance: Choose Book Test Drive to try the seating, visibility and gearbox response, then obtain a current written quote for the selected variant.
fields.notes: Use the exact selected configurations for comparisons: Nexon Fearless + PS 1.2 turbo petrol seven-speed DCA, Brezza ZXi+ 1.5 K15C petrol ISG six-speed automatic, regular Venue HX10 1.0 Turbo GDi petrol seven-speed DCT. These are comparison examples, not inferred buyer selections. Use only current approved registry evidence. Standard safety equipment and manufacturer-reported crash results are separate; BNCAP scope is petrol/diesel trims active May 2026. Ground clearance does not establish water capability; boot capacity does not establish luggage fit. Ordinary figures are stated, not certified. Preserve all trim/fuel and introductory finance conditions in the same answer. Do not compute unapproved performance or cost deltas. Resolve policy with written terms, financing with the lender, feel/fit with the buyer's own check.
